summary: Deployment checks use executor permissions, with consistent terminal diagnostics and actionable secrets recovery.
highlights: Operations deployment checks run in the executor without granting the network-facing agent access to secrets.
Terminal checks verify executor access too; restricted files report the affected host UID and a precise Linux recovery command.
The optional OCR service joins generated restart and lifecycle allowlists; project-image updates include OCR with the application services.
Wrapper 4 keeps Windows PowerShell 5.1 launchers ASCII-safe and matches the DjangoLux scaffold.
Retains verified Composer 1.8 stable service protections and existing restart, recreate, update and maintenance behavior.
